name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: cutover verification and legacy cleanup
description:
## Why?

Because the rewrite lands tab by tab, the page runs in a mixed state for the whole epic: React tabs alongside external-tab links into the legacy page. This task closes that state, removes the bridge and deletes what is left of the Smarty family, so the migration does not leave a permanent hybrid behind.

## What?

Run the final verification and cleanup once all tab tasks are closed. Remove the external-tab bridge, delete the remaining legacy templates, and finish the rewrite record.

Deletion must respect shared consumers: `sub/ServiceDetail/ServiceDetailTabs.tpl` is also consumed by `PartnerServiceRatings.tpl` and `PartnerServiceShippingServiceDetail.tpl`, and a same-named twin exists at `crm/admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/ServiceDetailTabs.tpl` which must not be touched. `PartnerServiceController` is an abstract base with 10 children and must not be modified for the benefit of this page alone.

## Acceptance Criteria

- No external-tab bridge entries remain; every tab renders natively in React
- `/st-tpl-to-react-check` passes with no unresolved parity rows
- `admin/controllers/templates/PartnerServiceAdd.tpl` deleted, and every `sub/ServiceDetail/` partial whose last consumer was this page deleted
- `ServiceDetailTabs.tpl` only deleted if no live page still consumes it; the CRM twin under `crm/admin/` untouched
- `PartnerServiceController` (abstract base) unmodified
- Modal controllers still reachable and working: `PartnerServiceSubmit`, `PartnerServiceInstall`, `PartnerServiceEndpoints`, `PartnerServiceEndPointModify`, `PartnerServiceShippingServiceDetail`
- `saveAndExit` still redirects to `ApiPartner`
- Rewrite record `docs/tpl-to-react/rewrites/PartnerServiceAdd.md` complete; learning rule files added under `docs/tpl-to-react/check-learnings/`
- Manual pass on the dev shop across create, edit, a shipping service and a service with `enableHtmlInclude`
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test`, `make fe-build-admin` green
